body:
nginx default 1MB body limit was blocking real uploads (e.g. NOCK glTF animation import, ~3MB) before they reached IDUNA. Fixed in ops/nginx-okemily.conf (both server blocks, matches IDUNA's own 64MB cap). Live deploy queued as sudo-queue/80, not yet applied -- needs founder sudo. Commit OKEMILY 8a2a597.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix 413 on uploads: client_max_body_size
